# Organic Soil Wholesale by Soil Seed & Water

Organic Soil Wholesale by Soil Seed & Water sells organic compost, worm castings, potting soil, and mulch for Arizona gardens, landscapes, farms, nurseries, and commercial projects.

Website: https://organicsoilwholesale.com
Main buying page: https://organicsoilwholesale.com/products
Phone: (623) 263-3386
Primary bulk pickup address: 18980 Stanton Rd, Congress, AZ 85332
Congress pickup map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/TkrzEwmyxXqPeNGeA

Receiving hours:
- Tuesday-Saturday: 8:00 AM-1:00 PM
- Closed daily: 1:00 PM-2:00 PM
- Tuesday-Saturday: 2:00 PM-4:00 PM

Service area:
- Bulk pickup customers choose Congress or Phoenix at checkout.
- Congress bulk pickup is best for scale/weighed orders and can be ready in about 30 minutes during pickup hours.
- Phoenix pickup is available for bags, pallets, and totes.
- Phoenix loose bulk pickup is by appointment only and should be scheduled about 1 week ahead.
- Delivery is available when the order and destination qualify.
- Delivery service area is generally within 300 miles of Phoenix or Congress, Arizona.

Main products:
- Simon's Gold: dairy compost for soil rebuilding, feeding, organic matter, beds, trees, and planted areas.
- Mikey's Worm Poop: worm castings for root zones, top dressing, seed starts, garden beds, and soil biology.
- PlantPal: all-stage potting mix for seed starts, propagation, containers, nurseries, and patio planters.
- Nature's Blanket Premium: healthy soil mulch made with wood fiber, worm castings, and dairy compost for landscape finish, moisture retention, weed suppression, gardens, farms, and commercial properties.

Buying flow:
- Customers can select a product at /products.
- Product pages show available sizes and visible prices.
- Customers can add pickup products to cart and complete checkout.
- Truckload delivery orders require delivery details and delivery price confirmation.
- Congress pickup customers should use the Congress plant map pin. Phoenix loose bulk pickup requires a scheduled appointment.

Garden bundles and deals:
- https://organicsoilwholesale.com/offers — current deals and the raised garden bed community offer.
- https://organicsoilwholesale.com/offers/garden-refresh — $99 plus tax; 10 bags: 5 premium mulch, 3 dairy compost, 2 worm castings; 15 cu ft total.
- https://organicsoilwholesale.com/offers/garden-refresh-plus — $149 plus tax; 16 bags: 10 PlantPal, 3 premium mulch, 3 worm castings; 24 cu ft total.
- https://organicsoilwholesale.com/offers/big-garden-setup — $399 plus tax; 40 bags: 30 PlantPal, 4 dairy compost, 3 worm castings, 3 premium mulch; 58 cu ft total.
- These bagged-material bundles are Phoenix pickup offers. Raised bed frames, plants, irrigation, tools and delivery are not included. Mulch stays on the surface; coverage depends on fill depth and existing soil.
- The separate complete raised garden bed community offer has eligibility requirements and requires a personal offer link to pay. Consult its live page for current price and delivery terms; do not imply universal eligibility.

Our production process:
- https://organicsoilwholesale.com/operations — dairy compost windrows, worm farming, blending and loading, with real photos and videos.
- Soil health is considered through microbiology, nutrition and physical structure.
- Cyanobacteria (blue-green algae) are added to water used on dairy-compost windrows.

Delivery pricing:
- Ask whether the customer wants pickup or delivery before comparing prices.
- Use the live ZIP estimator and actual material and quantity for a delivered total before tax.
- Delivery is itemized separately on the receipt. Do not describe a delivery selling price as the carrier's underlying cost.
- Truck capacity and delivered rates depend on the material, load size, access and destination. Do not apply PlantPal's volume-to-weight relationship to compost or other materials.
